findings.reason: Storage Drawers ships its CoFH personal-key recipe without a mod_loaded condition; CoFH Core is not in the pack, so the CoFH-only key is uncraftable by design.
Productive Bees' Create Enchantment Industry mixing recipe targets a hyper-experience fluid that CEI 2.5 no longer registers; the recipe is skipped silently. Upstream compat drift, harmless.
Supplementaries makes cannonballs from lead blocks only when some mod provides lead; the pack has none since AllTheOres left, so its iron recipe is the intended one.
